paite: Tu in zaw, Jakob aw, TOUPA nou hon siampa leh, Israel aw, nang hon bawlpa'n, hichi in achi: Lau ke'n, ka hon tanta hi; na min in ka hon sam a, kei a na hi hi.
heading: Pathian In Amite Hotkhiak Achiam
english: But now thus says Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

paite: Tuite na ngah tan lai in na kiang ah ka om ding a; luite na ngah tan lai in leng ahon tum kei ding hi; mei a na pai tan lai in leng ahon hul kei ding a; meikuang in ahon liau kei ding hi.
english: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

paite: Kei, TOUPA na Pathian, Israelte Mi Siangthou, nang hon humbitpa ka hi ngal a; na tatna ding in Aigupta gam ka pia a, Ethiopia leh Seba gam na sik in ka pia hi.
english: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

paite: Ka ngaih in manpha mahmah na hi a, mizahtakhuai mahmah leng na hi hi, it leng ka hon it ziak in, na sik in mite ka pe ding a, na hinna sik ding in michih ka pe ding hi.
english: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you; therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.

paite: Lau kei in, na kiang ah ka om ngal a; na suante suahlam a kipan ka hon pi ding a, tumlam a kipan ka hon pikhawm ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid; for I am with you. I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west.

paite: Mallam kiang ah, khah in, ka chi ding a; simlam kiang ah, len kei in, ka chi ding; ka tapate gamlapi a kipan hon pi inla, ka tanute kawlmong a kipan hon pi in;
english: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

paite: Ka min po peuhmahte leh ka thupina ding a ka siam peuhmahte; amau ka bawl a, ahi, amau ka suktuahte ahi uhi.
english: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”

paite: Mit nei ngal a mittawte leh, bil nei ngal a nangongte, pikhia un.
heading: TOUPA Theihpihtu Ahi
english: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

paite: Nam chih kikhawm uhenla, michih omkhawm uhen; alak ua kua ahia hiai gen thei a, tuma lam in thilte hon theisak thei? Siamtansak a a-omtheihna ding un apalaite uh hon pi uhen; ahihkeileh bil in za uhenla, thutak ahi, chi uhen.
english: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”

paite: "Noute ka theihpihtute na hi uh" TOUPA'N achi; "Ka sikha ka mitelsate, kei amah ka hi chih thei a, na gintak ua, na theihsiamna ding un. Ka om ma in Pathian bawlkhiak in a-om kei a, ka om nung in leng a-om sam kei ding.
english: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

paite: "Kei, kei mahmah, TOUPA ka hi; keimah lou ngal hondampa a-om kei hi.
english: I myself am Yahweh; and besides me there is no savior.

paite: Ke'n ka gen a, ka hondam a, ka theisak a, na lak uah gamdang pathian a-om kei hi; huaiziak in noute ka palaite na hi uh, TOUPA'N achi, kei Pathian ka hi.
english: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown; and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “and I am God.

paite: Ahi, ni om nungsang kei bamah ka hi; huchi in ka khut a kipan hunkhe thei kuamah a-om kei uh; nna ka sem a, kua'n ahia huai hei ding?
english: Yes, since the day was I am he; and there is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

paite: TOUPA, nou hon tanpa, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi: Nou ziak in Babulon ah sepaihte ka sawl a, huchi in avek un, Kaldaite, akipahna longpi uah taimang mi pi in ka pisuk ding.
heading: Babulon A Pan Suahtakna
english: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

paite: Kei TOUPA, na Mi Siangthou uh, Israelte Siampa, na Kumpipa uh ka hi,” chi in.
english: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”

paite: Tuipi a lampi bawlpa leh, tui thupi mahmahte a paina ding bawlpa, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Thus says Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

paite: "Kangtalai leh sakol, sepaihte leh thilhihtheihna a pikhepa'n, huaite alumkhawm zengzung ua, athounawnta kei ding uh; achimit khin ua, khawnvak puan mihsak bang in mihsak in a-omta uh," chi in.
english: who brings forth the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick):

paite: Tuma lam thilte zaw theigige kei unla, nidanglai thilte ngaihtuah sam kei un.
english: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.

paite: Ngai un, thil thak ka hih ding; tua kipan in adawnkhe ding; huai na thei kei ding ua hia? Gamdai nangawn ah lampi ka bawl ding a, gamkeu ah leng luite ka bawl ding.
english: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs forth now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

paite: Gamsate'n leng hon pahtawi ding ua, sehalte, vasa ngawngsaute tan in; gamdai a tuite ka omsak ziak leh gamkeu a luite ka omsak ziak in, ka mi, ka telte kiang a dawn ding a piak ding.
english: The animals of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

paite: Hiai mite kei a ding in ka bawl a; kei phatna ahihlang ding uhi.
english: the people which I formed for myself, that they might set forth my praise.

paite: Himahleh Jakobte aw, nou zaw na hon sam kei ua, Israelte aw, nou zaw nawn chimtak zawta uhi.
heading: Israel Khelhna
english: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.

paite: Haltum thillat gannoute na hon lak ngei kei ua; na kithoihnate un na hon pahtawi sam kei uh. Thillat in na ka hon semsak ngei kei a, begaw in ka hon hihgim ngei kei hi.
english: You have not brought me of your sheep for burnt offerings; neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

paite: Kawltu dangka in na hon leisak ngei kei ua, na kithoihna thaute un na hon taisak ngei kei uh; na khelhnate uh puak nasepte na hon semsak ua, na tatleknate un na hon hihgim zawta uhi.
english: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.

paite: Kei, kei mahmah, keimah leh keimah ziak lel a, na tatlekna uh nulmangpa ka hi; na khelhnate uh leng ka theigige nawnta kei ding.
english: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.

paite: Hon theihpih un; ngaihtuah chiat ni; siamtansak a na omtheihna ding un na thu uh gen un.
english: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Set forth your case, that you may be justified.

paite: Na pu masapen uh akhial a, na thugen mite uh leng ka tung ah atalek uhi.
english: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.

paite: Huaiziak in Mun Siangthou a miliante ka hihbuah ding a, huchi in Jakobte hamsethuak ding in ka bawl ding a; Israelte muhdah ding in ka bawl ding hi.
english: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
